name: AuSom Enterprise Limited
summary: AuSom Enterprise Limited operates as a trading company in India. The company trades in commodities, bullions, gold jewelry, diamonds, derivatives, shares and securities, and units of mutual funds; and manufactures and sells gold bars and jewelry. AuSom Enterprise Limited was formerly known as Core Emballage Limited. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
